title: Ethiopian Kitfo Stir-Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir-fry dish made with kitfo, kicked up with the bold flavors of Ethiopia. This gluten-free recipe is perfect for meat lovers.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add kitfo and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add corned beef and cook until heated through.
Add beef broth and kicked chili flakes, stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in peppery arugula, if using.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional arugula if desired.
